outcome: Maternal adverse outcomes (major obstetric hemorrhage, hysterectomy, embolization)
Perinatal adverse outcomes (perinatal asphyxia, neonatal intensive care unit admission)
cohort: Pregnant women in the Netherlands with uterine rupture
finding: The incidence of complete uterine rupture was 2.5 per 10,000 births, and the incidence of uterine rupture with adverse outcome was 0.9 per 10,000 births.
